dct_description_sm:
Screenline Counting Stations are located along a screenline wherever counts are conducted, usually located where roads, transitways and bike/walkways cross the screenline.

Screenlines are imaginary lines typically drawn along features such as rivers or railways, which have a minimum number of crossing points, making it more manageable to count traffic going from one side to the other. A screenline (e.g. LN02, LN10) is made up of several stations placed to count east-west or north-south travel which in total capture all major travel routes across the imaginary screenline. The screenlines are located along geographical barriers, i.e.: rivers, greenbelt - generally where a number of major transportation facilities are the main flow. To be truly representative of the flow, there is a station at each intersecting road, transit, and bike/walkway path on the screenline.

Date created: June 29, 2026 
Update frequency: As required
Accuracy: Not intended to represent exact location on the ground

Attributes

  • SL_NUM (Screenline Number)
  • STATION_ID (Screenline Counting Station ID)
  • CORDON_EN (Cordon - screenlines or groups of screenlines that describe an area of interest (English text))
  • CORDON_FR (Cordon - screenlines or groups of screenlines that describe an area of interest (French text))
  • NAME_EN (Screenline Counting Station name (English text))
  • NAME_FR (Screenline Counting Station name (French text))
  • NAME_TEXT1_EN (Screenline Counting Station name part 1 (English text))
  • NAME_TEXT1_FR (Screenline Counting Station name part 2 (English text))
  • NAME_TEXT2_EN (Screenline Counting Station name part 1 (French text))
  • NAME_TEXT2_FR (Screenline Counting Station name part 2 (French text))
  • SEASON_EN (Season that the traffic count was captured (English text))
  • SEASON_FR (Season that the traffic count was captured (French text))
  • DURATION (Traffic count recording duration in hours)
  • COUNTYEAR_EN ((Both = Count Collection during All Years / Even = Count Collection during Even Years / Odd = Count Collection during Odd Years) - describes when the count takes place (English text))
  • COUNTYEAR_FR (Les deux = Comptage à chaque année / Paires = Comptage pendant les années paires / Impaires = Comptage pendant les années impaires) - describes when the count takes place (French text))
  • STATION_TYPE_EN (Station Type (English text))
  • STATION_TYPE_FR (Station Type (French text))
  • NEWYEAR_EN (Year when the screenline count station was implemented (English text))
  • NEWYEAR_FR (Year when the screenline count station was implemented (French text))
  • CHANGE_EN (English text describing a change to a screenline count station)
  • CHANGE_FR (French text describing a change to a screenline count station)
  • FLOW_EN (Boolean flag indicating that the change to the screenline count station result in a change to the counted traffic flows (English text))
  • FLOW_FR (Boolean flag indicating that the change to the screenline count station result in a change to the counted traffic flows (French text))
  • DECOM_EN (Screenline Counting Station decommission status (English text))
  • DECOM_FR (Screenline Counting Station decommission status (French text))
  • YEAR (Year the traffic count was captured)
  • STATUS_EN (Latest – English text describing the data as the most recent captured)
  • STATUS_FR (Dernier en date – French text describing the data as the most recent captured)
